answer.summary: All 26 AttackPathHttpIsolationTest errors fail on the same deterministic DB guard: the test's INSERT INTO roles is refused by the PL/pgSQL function require_tenant_write (tenant_write_value) with 'outside the scope of the transaction'. This is not a flake (0 prior flakes, failed before too), and the change touches the roles guard migration V6 and PlatformRoleService, so a rerun will likely fail the same way. Check the tenant-write guard and transaction scoping for role inserts in the test setup. Log does not show the migration body itself, so the link to the change is inferred.
